title: P-cap2: '(reserved)' is not part of a capability name
description: draft-ietf-mimi-room-policy-04 Table 1 prints names such as 'canCreateJoinCode (reserved)'. Readings: (a) the suffix is part of the registered name; (b) it is a status marker. Chosen: (b). §8.7 lists the same capabilities by bare name, and a name with a space and parentheses is not a camelCase identifier like every other entry. Capability::name returns the bare name.
